lens_findings_considered.finding: Structural support only (not run): runtime sets live.started=true (1215) before awaiting host.spawnAgent, so a skip/retry during the beforeDispatch await calls abortAgent while controllers has no entry and sessions has none for a fresh agent - a no-op; the hypothesis remains unreproduced.

Over-broad quantifier in 03: C0353 includes workflow 'cancel' among the operations that 'can result in a late, unauthorized SDK start', but 01 (C0214) and the pinned code+test F10 show the run-level abort IS re-checked after the await; only per-agent skip/retry lacks the token. The norm C0352 (test both) is fine; the inference C0353 should drop 'cancel'.
lens_findings_considered.drift: 01 'skip ... can miss (workflow abort re-checked)' -> 03 'cancel/skip/retry ... late unauthorized start'

lens_findings_considered.finding: The race is a code-reading derivation at the pin for a FRESH spawn: abortAgent during the beforeDispatch await is a no-op (no controller, sessions.has(agentId) false so no pendingLookupAbort), the SDK query then starts, and the runtime takes the skipped flag from the result not the intent, so the skip is silently lost and the agent settles as a normal completion; no test or live receipt at the pin exercises this sequence, so it stays HYPOTHESIS-grade (unreproduced), not an observed defect.
